name: broadcast-channel-sync
description: Cross-tab + cross-iframe state sync using the browser BroadcastChannel API with localStorage fallback for older engines. Frontend-only, zero backend dependency.
notes: Pure-browser slice — no Convex schema or env vars. Falls back to `storage` event when BroadcastChannel unavailable (Safari < 15.4). Wrap consumer-side in `useSyncExternalStore` for React 19 concurrent-safe reads.
